name: Koplin Reach
description: A working Directory grouping for Koplin and nearby systems participating in the young Commonwealth interstellar frontier. The foundation lore establishes a small frontier of survey stations and resource outposts beyond Koplin by Year 5300; the named secondary systems in this grouping are generated expansion content unless separately source-linked.
history: Commonwealth interstellar expansion is still young in Year 5326. Nearby commercial and survey infrastructure has begun to form around routes made practical by the Vector Exchange Drive, while most off-world industry remains inside the Koplin system.
